title: Machine learning builds a five-gene HLA classifier for sepsis diagnosis and prognosis
summary: Across nine transcriptome datasets (1,251 patients), random forest and a modified Lasso selected five HLA genes (B2M, HLA-DQA1, HLA-DPA1, TAP1, TAP2) for a classifier with diagnostic AUC 0.997 in the discovery cohort and mortality AUC 0.716. ArrayExpress datasets served as external validation, and qRT-PCR in clinical samples confirmed expression differences. The data are public and retrospective, and prognostic accuracy is modest.
ai_technology: Random forest and modified Lasso penalized regression for hub gene selection and classifier construction
organization: The First People's Hospital of Shunde; Southern Medical University

evidence.tested: External ArrayExpress validation and qRT-PCR of HLA gene expression in clinical samples.
evidence.unknown: The qRT-PCR sample size and clinical benefit are not given in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Identified the five hub genes and built the classifier.
